why: A July 2025 blog post ('Definitive Resolution of the Eilenberg–Ganea Conjecture via Twisted Bredon Cohomology') claims a disproof and attributes it to Grok 4, but it is self-published on a personal blog with no peer review or arXiv trace found, so it is unclear whether this is a credible claim worth counting. No other post-snapshot source (survey, arXiv preprint, or Wikipedia article edit) reports movement; a GitHub formalization-tracking issue from 2026-01-20 is unrelated to any mathematical progress.
